Categories.value: Parque La Concepción|Self-published work|Religious buildings in Málaga|On OSM|Files with coordinates missing SDC location of creation|Photos by User:Dcapillae|2021 in Málaga|Our Lady of Joy

ImageDescription.value: Hermitage of the Hermandad Romera de la Virgen de la Alegría (Pilgrim Brotherhood of the Virgin of Joy), located in La Concepción Forest Park, in Málaga, Spain. Roof-shaped building with a back wall and a Christian cross on top. It is used as a hermitage during the pilgrimage of the Virgen de la Alegría held in September. The rest of the year it remains empty and unused.
